strategies.name: 2-Minute Version
strategies.description: Do just 2 minutes of the task to build momentum. Set a timer and commit to stopping after 2 minutes if you want.

strategies.name: First Step Only
strategies.description: Identify and do ONLY the very first physical action. Don't think about step 2.

strategies.name: Break It Down Further
strategies.description: The task is still too big. Break it into even smaller 5-10 minute chunks.

strategies.name: Define 'Done' First
strategies.description: Before starting, write down exactly what 'done' looks like. What's the specific deliverable?

strategies.name: Body Doubling
strategies.description: Work alongside someone (in person, video call, or even a focus stream). Their presence helps maintain focus.

strategies.name: Reward After
strategies.description: Set up a specific reward you'll get after completing the task. Make it something you actually want.

strategies.name: Permission to Suck
strategies.description: Give yourself explicit permission to do it badly. A bad first draft is better than no draft.

strategies.name: Brain Dump First
strategies.description: Before the task, dump everything on your mind into a list. Clear the mental clutter.

strategies.name: Phone in Another Room
strategies.description: Physically put your phone in another room. Out of sight, out of mind.

strategies.name: Screen Time Lock
strategies.description: Use Screen Time (iOS) or Digital Wellbeing (Android) to block distracting apps during work hours.

strategies.name: Use Focus App
strategies.description: Use a focus app like Forest, Freedom, or Cold Turkey to block distractions completely.

strategies.name: Basic Needs Check
strategies.description: Check: Have you eaten? Hydrated? Slept? Sometimes the problem is physical, not mental.

strategies.name: Take a Real Break
strategies.description: Step away completely for 15-20 minutes. Walk, stretch, get outside. Don't look at screens.

strategies.name: Match Task to Energy
strategies.description: Do high-focus tasks when you have energy (morning). Save low-energy tasks for afternoons.

strategies.name: Ruthless Triage
strategies.description: Cross off or defer anything that isn't truly essential. You can only do one thing at a time.

strategies.name: Identify the Actual Block
strategies.description: Ask: What SPECIFICALLY am I waiting on? Can I work around it? Can I ask for help right now?

strategies.name: Pomodoro Technique
strategies.description: Work for 25 minutes, then take a 5 minute break. Use a timer.

strategies.name: Shorter Pomodoro (10 min)
strategies.description: 25 minutes too long? Try 10 minutes of work, then a 3 minute break.

strategies.name: Change Environment
strategies.description: Move to a different location - coffee shop, different room, outside. New environment = new focus.

strategies.name: Ask for Help
strategies.description: Reach out to someone who can help - a coworker, friend, or expert. You don't have to do it alone.

strategies.name: Accountability Partner
strategies.description: Tell someone your goal and deadline. Check in with them when done.

strategies.name: Lower the Stakes
strategies.description: Remind yourself: This doesn't have to be perfect. What's the minimum viable version?

strategies.name: Reschedule to Tomorrow
strategies.description: Sometimes today isn't the day. Move it to tomorrow's peak energy time.

strategies.name: Swap for Different Task
strategies.description: Can't do this task right now? Swap it for a different task that matches your current energy.
